packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major npm updates
Group and automerge non-major GitHub Actions
Group Tailwind packages together (all update types)

Group the Astro framework + its adapters/integrations together across ALL update types, so a major (e.g. astro 6->7 with @astrojs/cloudflare 13->14 and @astrojs/preact 4->6) lands as ONE coherent PR. Renovate otherwise opens a separate PR per package for majors, and a partial bump leaves the set incompatible (the adapter peers a specific astro major) and fails the build with `Missing field moduleType`. See checkout-site-engine#154. Majors still do not automerge (the last rule guards that) - the grouped PR opens for review.

Group wrangler with the @cloudflare packages and do not separate majors. Carried here as well as in default.json for the same reason the astro rule is: this preset groups all non-major npm updates as `npm non-major`, so without a later rule a wrangler MINOR would land in that group while the @cloudflare/workers-types MAJOR it requires landed separately -- which is precisely how happy-house-bathrooms#45 and #57 split. Majors still do not automerge (the last rule guards that).

Internal packages - minor/patch automerge. site-functions was excluded here until 2026-08-23 on the grounds that it is runtime-only and never executed by site CI, which left fleet-bump as its only carrier - and nothing ran fleet-bump, so a security fix sat undeployed on 9 of 10 sites for ten days (marketing-site-engine#460). Two things make the exclusion unnecessary: `astro check` DOES typecheck functions/, so a type-breaking change fails the PR; and the fleet smoke now POSTs a honeypot-filled body to each deployed handler daily, so a bundle that ships broken is caught within a day rather than when a customer submits a form. Majors still stay manual via the last rule.
Safety guard: never automerge major updates (must stay last to override the group rules above)
